description: Advances a vertical coordinate, updates the sprite position registers, then enables sprite DMA when the sprite is inside the visible window and disables it otherwise.

key: Kick Off 2 (1990)(Anco)[cr Oracle][tr Tu].adf boot-block load +$1600 to $030000 (140288 bytes):0:B9EC
name: show_sprite_if_visible
description: Sets a control byte from a register argument, then enables sprite DMA when the sprite lies inside the visible window and disables it otherwise.

key: Kick Off 2 (1990)(Anco)[cr Oracle][tr Tu].adf boot-block load +$1600 to $030000 (140288 bytes):0:BA10
name: toggle_sprite_dma_visibility
description: Enables sprite DMA when the sprite lies inside the visible window and disables it when it does not, calling a routine on the visible branch.

key: Kick Off 2 (1990)(Anco)[cr Oracle][tr Tu].adf boot-block load +$1600 to $030000 (140288 bytes):0:BA42
name: disable_sprite_dma_clear_regs
description: Writes the sprite DMA-off value to the DMA control register, then zeroes six sprite registers in the custom chip block.

key: Kick Off 2 (1990)(Anco)[cr Oracle][tr Tu].adf boot-block load +$1600 to $030000 (140288 bytes):0:BABC
name: reload_block_on_scroll_change
description: When a scroll value differs from its last stored copy, saves the new value and loads a resource in a loop until it succeeds. It then reads a width and height from its header, sets up two pointers from the data, and calls routines to finish the setup.

key: Kick Off 2 (1990)(Anco)[cr Oracle][tr Tu].adf boot-block load +$1600 to $030000 (140288 bytes):0:BBDA
name: toggle_bit_and_loop
description: Repeats forever: sets bit two of a byte through a pointer, calls a routine, clears that bit again, and calls another routine. It never returns.

key: Kick Off 2 (1990)(Anco)[cr Oracle][tr Tu].adf boot-block load +$1600 to $030000 (140288 bytes):0:BC02
name: wait_for_bit_set_timeout
description: Clears bit four of a byte through a pointer, then polls for that bit to be set by hardware, giving up after a bounded number of polls. Each poll first waits for a word at a pointer to become non-negative.

key: Kick Off 2 (1990)(Anco)[cr Oracle][tr Tu].adf boot-block load +$1600 to $030000 (140288 bytes):0:BC22
name: search_byte_pattern_read_word
description: Searches a stream of bytes for the byte D followed by a second fixed byte, retrying within a bounded count. It then skips to a fixed position and returns the next word.

key: Kick Off 2 (1990)(Anco)[cr Oracle][tr Tu].adf boot-block load +$1600 to $030000 (140288 bytes):0:BC6A
name: check_pointer_and_set_flag
description: Waits for the word at a pointer to become non-negative several times, stores a fixed value of 4096 in a word further along the block, waits up to six times for a status bit to be set, and returns the word at the pointer.

key: Kick Off 2 (1990)(Anco)[cr Oracle][tr Tu].adf boot-block load +$1600 to $030000 (140288 bytes):0:BC9C
name: poll_word_ready_loop
description: Polls the word at a pointer until it becomes non-negative several times, comparing values in a loop that only exits through its early returns.

key: Kick Off 2 (1990)(Anco)[cr Oracle][tr Tu].adf boot-block load +$1600 to $030000 (140288 bytes):0:BCA0
name: wait_until_byte_differs
description: Waits for the word at a pointer to become ready, then returns as soon as its low byte differs from the byte passed in a data register. The other comparisons in its loop compare a value with itself.

key: Kick Off 2 (1990)(Anco)[cr Oracle][tr Tu].adf boot-block load +$1600 to $030000 (140288 bytes):0:BCD4
name: poll_device_register_loop
description: Repeats 120 times: writes three control bytes to a device block and waits for a status bit in the first byte to clear before the next pass.

key: Kick Off 2 (1990)(Anco)[cr Oracle][tr Tu].adf boot-block load +$1600 to $030000 (140288 bytes):0:BCF4
name: stub_empty_return
description: Returns immediately without doing any work.

key: Kick Off 2 (1990)(Anco)[cr Oracle][tr Tu].adf boot-block load +$1600 to $030000 (140288 bytes):0:BCF6
name: set_bits_then_poll_device
description: Sets bit one of a byte through a pointer, calls a routine, clears bit zero of a second byte and sets bit zero of a third, then repeats the device write loop 13 times, waiting on the status bit each pass.

key: Kick Off 2 (1990)(Anco)[cr Oracle][tr Tu].adf boot-block load +$1600 to $030000 (140288 bytes):0:BCFC
name: clear_bit_then_poll_device
description: Clears bit zero of a byte through a pointer, calls a routine, sets bit zero of another byte, then repeats the device write loop 13 times, waiting on the status bit each pass.

key: Kick Off 2 (1990)(Anco)[cr Oracle][tr Tu].adf boot-block load +$1600 to $030000 (140288 bytes):0:BD0C
name: step_position_then_poll_device
description: Steps two 16-bit values toward each other one at a time until they are equal, clearing bit one of a byte on one branch. Then it repeats the device write loop 120 times.

key: Kick Off 2 (1990)(Anco)[cr Oracle][tr Tu].adf boot-block load +$1600 to $030000 (140288 bytes):0:BD16
name: wait_until_values_match
description: Clears bit one of a byte, then fetches values through a routine, stepping until one equals the other, and runs the device write loop 120 times once they match.

key: Kick Off 2 (1990)(Anco)[cr Oracle][tr Tu].adf boot-block load +$1600 to $030000 (140288 bytes):0:BE36
name: fill_index_table_rows
description: Sets two state fields and a pointer, then fills a table of 16-bit values, 20 per row over 32 rows, with a running index that advances by two within each row and jumps by a fixed step between rows.

key: Kick Off 2 (1990)(Anco)[cr Oracle][tr Tu].adf boot-block load +$1600 to $030000 (140288 bytes):0:BE76
name: store_longword_in_slot_table
description: Stores a 32-bit argument as two 16-bit halves into a table entry chosen by a register index, with entries eight bytes apart.

key: Kick Off 2 (1990)(Anco)[cr Oracle][tr Tu].adf boot-block load +$1600 to $030000 (140288 bytes):0:BE92
name: invoke_six_routines_in_order
description: Makes six calls to library routines in sequence and returns, with no other work.

key: Kick Off 2 (1990)(Anco)[cr Oracle][tr Tu].adf boot-block load +$1600 to $030000 (140288 bytes):0:BEC4
name: write_strided_entry_table
description: Writes a shared value and a position derived from the arguments into a set of table entries, each one offset from the last by eight, sixteen, twenty-four, thirty-two and forty bytes.

key: Kick Off 2 (1990)(Anco)[cr Oracle][tr Tu].adf boot-block load +$1600 to $030000 (140288 bytes):0:BF56
name: setup_display_and_copper
description: Clears two large buffers, programs the display window, data fetch range, bitplane modulo and control registers, the colour registers and the copper list pointer, then enables bitplane and copper DMA.

key: Kick Off 2 (1990)(Anco)[cr Oracle][tr Tu].adf boot-block load +$1600 to $030000 (140288 bytes):0:C286
name: blit_lookup_rows_twenty_passes
description: Waits for the blitter to go idle, programs its modulo, control and size registers, then runs twenty passes. Each pass sets a destination pointer from a table lookup and starts a one-word-wide, 48-row blit.
